title: Four-day variance-ratio conditioned positive persistence for BTC long or cash
thesis: Conditioning a positive prior-28-complete-day BTC trend state on a descriptive overlapping four-day variance ratio strictly above one may retain enough upside while avoiding trend states whose path dependence is too weak to justify exposure.
mechanism: At each complete UTC-day close, use exactly 29 closes to form 28 one-day log returns and 25 overlapping four-day log-return sums. Divide the unbiased sample variance of the four-day sums by four times the unbiased sample variance of the one-day returns. At the immediately following H1 open, hold full-capital unlevered BTC only when this ratio is strictly greater than one and the latest close is strictly greater than the close 28 days earlier; otherwise hold zero-yield cash. Exactly one variant is allowed.
economic_rationale: The variance-ratio condition is economically useful only if it adds risk-adjusted value beyond the simpler positive-28-day-trend parent under identical capital, execution, valuation and costs, while also retaining meaningful passive-BTC upside. Positive aggregate return alone is insufficient: Design, Validation, doubled friction, annual breadth, drawdown path, Calmar, concentration, holding and terminal inventory must all pass frozen gates.
